And, with the view of meeting this evasion, we must begin by enquiring into the nature of language, opinion, and imagination, in order that

when we find them we may find also that they have communion with not-being, and, having made out the connection of them, may thus prove that falsehood exists; and therein we will imprison the Sophist, if he deserves it, or, if not, we will let him go again and look for him in another class.
